items.question: What does a 5-year ceramic coating actually mean?
items.answer: The package is designed around a coating with up to five years of protection when maintained as directed. Actual longevity depends on use, storage and care. We’ll explain the product, maintenance requirements and any written warranty before you book. Ceramic coating is not scratch-proof.

items.question: Will paint correction remove every scratch?
items.answer: No. Correction reduces swirls, haze and light defects. Deep scratches and compromised clear coat may need body-shop repair. We inspect paint thickness and agree on a safe result before work begins.

items.question: Is the price I see the final price?
items.answer: The calculator gives a starting estimate for your vehicle size. Heavy contamination, pet hair or significant paint defects can require extra time. You approve the final scope and price after inspection, before work starts.

items.question: Can I drop off my vehicle and collect it the same day?
items.answer: Express details are generally completed the same day. Paint correction takes longer, and the ceramic package needs 2–3 days including cure time. We confirm turnaround with your appointment.

items.question: Does submitting a request confirm my appointment?
items.answer: Not yet. Choose a time preference and we’ll contact you to confirm availability, your vehicle’s needs and the final quote. No payment is taken online.
